title: Expropriate
summary: EXPRO'PRIATE, verb transitive [Latin ex and proprius, own.] To disengage from appropriation; to hold no longer as one's own; to give up a claim to exclusive property.

inlines.v: EXPRO'PRIATE, verb transitive [Latin ex and proprius, own.] To disengage from appropriation; to hold no longer as one's own; to give up a claim to exclusive property.
